integrity: Proof and finite verification are included. Full priority against all specialist literature is not independently established; supplementary computation is not used to justify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple unit-edge bipartite graphs with side-specific integer maximum degrees p>q>=2 and ordinary unnormalized graph Laplacians; uniform sharpness via finite tree balls, not an equality-attaining finite graph; excludes weighted/directed/nonbipartite networks and accuracy assertions.
title: Sharp Crank–Nicolson positivity under asymmetric bipartite degree caps
